dataRecordMapping.description:
Provides a mapping from a data record returned by an api call, which may be in any shape,
to the shape required by the concrete data spec setting type implementation.

fieldName.description: The name of the field to which these settings apply

targetPage.description: The target page for the URL redirect link.

internal.description: Whether the link should be treated as an internal application link or an external link.

opensNewTab.description: Whether clicking the link to a new page will open a new tab. Only works if internal property is set to false.

urlText.description: Text to show for the url

actionSuffix.description: The action to dispatch when the user selects this option.
